profile.headline: Senior Staff Engineer specializing in DevOps practices
profile.summary: I am a persistent problem-solver, undaunted by open-ended problems or the need to up-skill on the job.  My goal is to transform ideas using clear processes into a smoothly running system.  In my current role I support Developer Teams by maintaining and building infrastructure, developing efficient internal processes, and improving visibility into system metrics for maximum performance and cost efficiency.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Identified and executed cloud infrastructure cost optimizations, reducing monthly operating expenses by thousands of dollars without sacrificing reliability.

Stabilized critical systems while navigating a company merger and platform consolidation.
Led end-to-end migration from Porter to Northflank (PaaS), improving developer experience and directly enabling the launch of new product lines.

Bridged infrastructure and product teams while managing relationships with third-party platform providers, consistently driving higher-quality outcomes and better contract terms
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Engineering Change Management · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · OpenTelemetry

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, implemented, and maintained CareRev's cloud infrastructure and software deployment pipelines using AWS, FluxCD, Github Actions, Kubernetes, Terraform and Istio. Monitored and resolved infrastructure and application-related issues using Datadog and RollBar. Refactored Terraform modules and upgraded system services by major versions. 

Sole owner of CareRev's cloud infrastructure for 1+ years, stabilizing critical systems while navigating a company merger and platform consolidation

Stepped into a Data Engineer role during staff reduction, owning all ELT pipelines and data infrastructure across Kafka, Confluent, dbt, and Debezium with no disruption to delivery. Supported executive leaders and clients in accessing and transforming reporting and compliance data.

Automated EKS and Terraform workflows using GitHub Actions and Mergify, eliminating several hours of manual developer work per week

Reduced security vulnerabilities across the GitHub org by over 50% through elimination of unused IAM users, roles, and access credentials

Works closely with other senior engineering and product leaders to deliver the infrastructure necessary to change healthcare for the better.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Terraform · Flux · Istio · Data Engineering · Apache Kafka · Confluent

positions.title: System Operations Engineer
positions.description: Manages the system operations for music distribution software that serves over 1.5 million customers. Maintains CI/CD pipelines on Bitbucket, supports all environments and resources on AWS. Key team member in a transition from Windows servers to containerized auto-scaling deployments using Docker & Kubernetes.
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · Helm · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Datadog · Bash · Bitbucket · Windows Server · Linux Server · Sentry

positions.title: DevOps Consultant
positions.description: Harden CI pipelines to avoid silent failures and incomplete job steps. Improved performance of build & deployment job pipelines on Gitlab.  Right-size infrastructure to save costs. Separated tenant infrastructure across multiple Google Cloud Projects for a clear picture of per-tenant costs and to comply with privacy requirements. Used private networking across projects to secure communication between resources. Move plain-text secrets to secrets manager. Implement developer VPN for access to private resources.
positions.insights: Skills: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Gitlab · Linux System Administration · Bash · Cloud Networking · TypeScript

positions.title: Co-Founder & Infrastructure Lead
positions.description:
Talky Inc. has transitioned to its own business entity. I am part of small team of founders at Talky where I support the infrastructure that runs the simplest video chat service on the web. 

At Talky I manage Kubernetes clusters, CI/CD systems, Linux Servers, and PostgreSQL databases. I provide monitoring services and respond to emergency incidents. I contribute to our Node.js codebase and directly solve our customer's problems.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Bare Metal · DigitalOcean · Lua · DevOps · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kubernetes

positions.title: Dev/Ops & Process Guru
positions.description:
Manage, configure, and optimize infrastructure for applications including Talky.io, SimpleWebRTC and other projects. Maintain and update server infrastructure using Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Docker, and other cloud computing tools & platforms. Provide operational support to developers on projects and oversee deploys with CI/CD on Drone.io.  Build tools and automation scripts in Go, Node.js, and Bash to facilitate developer freedom. Help streamline and automate processes for simpler configuration, deployment, and scaling. Share in the responsibility to provide coverage for on-call emergency support.

Contribute to backend services and applications in Node.js. Reviews PRs and manages Github Issues. Builds and maintains API services with the Hapi.js framework, manages Postgres databases with knex/bookshelf.

Offers project management support for developer teams including client communication, invoicing, expectation management, and meeting facilitation. Chaired a working group to develop team-wide project management standards. Promotes a process-driven, people-centric culture and works to improve documentation and reduce technical debt wherever is it found.

positions.title: Proctor
positions.description: Proctors are on call for 24 shifts multiple times throughout the semester. We handle emergency situations, student conflicts and peer counseling and advising. We also coordinate dorm events, mediate conflict, and manage holistic student support.

positions.title: Academic Excellence Mathematics Tutor
positions.description: Tutors students of all years in Math courses including Proof-Based Calculus, Linear Algebra, Differential Equations, Discrete Math, and Probability and Statistics. The emphasis of tutoring was on conceptual mastery as well and homework help.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description: Tutored underclassmen in Computer Science courses by helping them with coding projects and clarifying concepts or syntax that may be unclear. Also assisted with grading of coursework. Courses Tutored: CS5 - Introduction of Computer Science, CS60 - Principles of Computer Science, CS131 - Programming Languages.

positions.title: Node Developer
positions.description:
Code. Debug. Code. Teach Waltz. Code. Debug. Code.
Overhauled and built extensively on a CRUD Node application called Endeavors which is used by the team to determine their next project. Team members can submit ideas to the app and the app allows for the entire team to collaborate, up-vote, or down-vote the idea, leave comments, and eventually turn the idea into a step-by-step project. Designed and built an application called Textcapade from scratch. Textcapade allows users to play a Create-Your-Own-Adventure game via SMS messaging. Occasionally acted as a waltz instructor and pianist as needed.

positions.title: Developer/Intern
positions.description:
- Developed curriculum for Triangleland, a game designed to teach geometry concepts to middle school and junior high students. 
- Worked collaboratively with a team via the internet to make decisions and code the game in java. 
- Redesigned the company site of starfishenterprise.net, a Home Owner's Association site, and am
- Currently building a site for a capital management club using the Wordpress platform. 
- Familiar with HMTL, CSS, PHP, and Javascript.

positions.title: Mathematics Tutor
positions.description:
- Tutors students of all ages from elementary school to adult in mathematics. 
- Comfortable tutoring Basic Arithmetic, Algebra, Geometry, Calculus, Probability & Statistics, Differential Equations, and Linear Algebra.
- Most recently I tutored several adult students in Statistics during the summer.

positions.title: Sales & Office Manager
positions.description:
- Created invoices, received payments for Intellicard, Inc., a small publishing company. 
- Wrote checks and deposit slips, paid bills, customer service via email, fax, and phone. 
- Packaged and shipped books and other informational products to locations internationally. 
- Skilled at using Quickbooks and in dealing with UPS shipping services.

positions.title: Lab Assistant
positions.description:
- Assisted with research in biotechnology lab doing tasks including polymerase chain reactions and gel electrophoresis. 
- Familiar with lab environment and equipment such as centrifuges and spectrometers and with using NCBI databases.

company.name: Round Rock Community College Biotech Lab

honors.title: Selected for HMC Proctor
honors.description: Students take an active role in overseeing and preserving the residential aspect of Harvey Mudd culture by becoming leaders on their campus. Proctors are selected in a competitive and rigorous process and serve for one academic year. These positions give students the opportunity to manage the dorm’s social and individual needs. Proctors are on call 24/7 and handle emergency situations, student conflicts and peer counseling and advising. Dorm presidents are responsible for leading dorm meetings, mediating discussions about facilities and services, coordinating social activities and responding to whole-dorm concerns.
honors.issuer: Issued by Harvey Mudd College - Division of Student Affairs · Aug 2015

honors.title: Featured on 10xLIST - Most Talented Female Engineers
honors.description:
Women on TenX are reviewed based on three things:
Educational Achievement: Performance in School and Learning Beyond the Classroom
Leadership Experiences: Initiative, Leadership roles and initiative taken
Practical Engineering Skills: Technical Skills, Hackathons, Complexity of roles at various companies you have worked at
TenXList is an invite-only community of top women engineers

volunteerExperiences.companyName: YAKIMA COUNTY SHERIFF SEARCH AND RESCUE
volunteerExperiences.description: Since Fall 2022 I have been a Search and Rescue volunteer with an emphasis in mountaineering & technical rescue. I regularly train with the rescue unit in order to improve my skills and participate in real-life rescue missions a few times a year. These missions involve a wide variety of circumstances, but most often include injured subjects in rugged terrain.

company.name: YAKIMA COUNTY SHERIFF SEARCH AND RESCUE

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Yakima Valley Society for Cultural Education
volunteerExperiences.description: Coordinated fundraisers and and formal events with budget of $20,000 for the YVSCE (yvsce.org) and the Dance Syndicate of Yakima. This organization is an arts and culture movements focused on developing the arts in Yakima Valley and mentoring young adults toward lives of purpose. I have planned and executed events such as dance exchanges, and classes, and small group meetings. My experience with this organization has built my relationship skills and helped me to understand how to lead a team towards a common mission and lead from my strengths.

company.name: Yakima Valley Society for Cultural Education

projects.title: Texcapade
projects.description: Textcapade is Create Your Own Adventure game where content is delivered via SMS. Components included PostgreSQL, Hapi Server, Node.js backend, and web portal accessible by a moderator. This project was built in the Summer of 2015 and launched at &yetconf (http://andyetconf.com/) in October 2015.

organizations.name: Women of the Association of Computing Machinery
